name: Drift 36
creator: AutoBlox Games
redeem: Launch Drift 36 on Roblox and wait until you spawn into the city.
Tap the small arrow button in the top-left corner of the screen, next to the chat icon.
Pick the Codes button from the menu that drops down.
Type or paste the code into the Enter Code box and press Redeem Code.
notes:
Drift 36 is a car game from AutoBlox Games set in an open city where you race other players, practice drifting and cruise around between events. Winning races pays out cash, which goes toward a garage of more than 80 cars and over 30 tuning and visual modifications. It runs on PC, mobile, Xbox and PlayStation 5, and joining the AutoBlox group adds a Group Member tag to your name.

Codes in Drift 36 pay out cash, usually tens of thousands of dollars per code, which is a quick way to afford a better car early on. AutoBlox tends to release them when the game hits visit, like or group-member milestones, and posts them in the game description and on its Discord.

faq.q: Where is the codes menu in Drift 36?
faq.a: Once you spawn into the city, tap the small arrow button in the top-left corner next to the chat icon and pick Codes from the menu that drops down. Type the code into the Enter Code box and press Redeem Code.

faq.q: What do Drift 36 codes give you?
faq.a: Drift 36 codes give in-game cash. Past codes paid between $15,000 and $50,000 each, and the current code 75MVISIT gives $40,000. You can spend the cash on more than 80 cars and over 30 modifications.

faq.q: When does AutoBlox Games release new Drift 36 codes?
faq.a: New codes tend to come out when the game reaches visit, like or group-member milestones, as with 75MVISIT, 120KLIKES and 1MGROUPMEMBER. AutoBlox posts them in the game description on Roblox and on its Discord.
